method.inference: Unchanged native PAN/MS; synchronized PAN/LP warp; signed HP; MS base once

R3_100.reference_rule: Resolve the original parent-bound complete reference. No substitution or recalibration in native arms.

R3_TA50.reference_rule: Resolve the original parent-bound complete reference. No substitution or recalibration in native arms.

R4_100.reference_rule: Resolve the original parent-bound complete reference. No substitution or recalibration in native arms.

R5_100.reference_rule: Resolve the original parent-bound complete reference. No substitution or recalibration in native arms.

P3OLD.purpose: Historical high-spatial endpoint; test-aware development anchor; exact50K, not RAW45450

augmentation.generation_domain: raw DN float64, then normalized float32
augmentation.order: source PAN -> gain -> LP generation -> fixed-HV/ROT4 view -> A -> synchronized warp -> H=P-L
augmentation.tau_rule: pooled band-mean abs error, unaugmented geometry, gamma median tokens 075/100/100/125, floor1e-6
augmentation.q_ref_rule: median calibration IDs x all four geometry views x gamma median tokens 075/100/100/125

expansion.s3: A07-A10 are stream robustness checks; A11-A16 only after H010 signal and budget
expansion.s4: Choose one K1/E100 if FT criteria pass; otherwise preregistered E100 fresh-path test. First fresh block is time/integrity gated, not FT-sign gated. B07-B10 are fresh transfer.
expansion.s5: First C07-C08 block tests fresh-path augmentation even after negative FT, provided integrity/time/safety. Second pair by pre-admission budget; no calibration retuning

selection.pair_comparison: same source parent/full state mapping, same local Teacher/data/stream/LR except declared factor
